parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, activities, assays. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno. activities to assays on assay_id. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217644'. activities.standard_relation = '='. activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, molecule_chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
